theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.DuasFaces.preserva_residuo
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (T : ATK.DuasFaces.LinhaR →ₗ[ℝ] ATK.DuasFaces.LinhaR),   Function.Injective ⇑T →     ∀ (x y : ATK.DuasFaces.LinhaR), ATK.DuasFaces.residuo (T x) (T y) = 0 ↔ ATK.DuasFaces.residuo x y = 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.DuasFaces.residuo_apply
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (a b c d : ℝ), ATK.DuasFaces.residuo (a, b) (c, d) = (a - c, b - d)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.DuasFaces.residuo_proprio
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (x : ATK.DuasFaces.LinhaR), ATK.DuasFaces.residuo x x = 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.DuasFaces.residuo_zero_iff
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (x y : ATK.DuasFaces.LinhaR), ATK.DuasFaces.residuo x y = 0 ↔ x = y

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.DuasFaces.singular_anula
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∃ T x y, ATK.DuasFaces.residuo x y ≠ 0 ∧ ATK.DuasFaces.residuo (T x) (T y) = 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.DuasFaces.telescopagem
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (D : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ), ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (D n - D (n + 1)) = D 0 - D N

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ATK.DuasFaces.transporte
